outcome_evidence: The drawer is initially closed (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches and closes its gripper around the upper drawer handle (frames 75–100, wrist_image), then pulls the drawer outward; its exposed side and opening are visible by frames 134–153 in image and left_ego_image. The robot releases the handle and withdraws (frames 220–246, wrist_image), leaving the drawer visibly open at frame 246 in image and left_ego_image. No failed acquisition, unwanted collision, or disturbance of unrelated objects is established.
